title: Support/Diagnostics Snapshot Bundle
description: Collects environment info, dmesg, journalctl, disk, network, process list, and (if present) Slurm/PBS status into one timestamped tarball on each target host, then fetches it back to the controller -- for attaching to a support ticket or archiving before/after a change.

variables.name: OUTPUT_DIR
variables.prompt: Directory on each target host to build the snapshot tarball in

variables.name: FETCH_DEST_DIR
variables.prompt: Local directory on the controller to fetch the tarballs into

toggles.name: INCLUDE_JOURNAL
toggles.prompt: Include the last 500 lines of the systemd journal

toggles.name: INCLUDE_SCHEDULER_STATUS
toggles.prompt: Include Slurm/PBS status output, if either is installed
